messages:
laura: Quick triage — we need to close audit logging coverage gaps across API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Focus: missing events, schema changes, KMS integration notes, and customer-facing validation. Can owners call out blockers? TL;DR: we should produce a prioritized backlog and migration plan.

sanju: grabbing current inventory now, will post the missing-event checklist in a few mins.

matt: do we have a single canonical event schema? if we change it, what's the compatibility story for customers? :thinking:

laura: short answer: prod has v1 and v1.1. we're proposing an additive v2 with explicit fields for KMS and RBAC metadata so clients don't have to parse details for key ops. minimal proposed additions: `kms_key_id`, `actor_identity_type`, `action_context`. Example event (for discussion):

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_12345",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T18:04:00Z",
  "service": "api-gateway",
  "actor": "user:alice@example.com",
  "actor_identity_type": "user",
  "action": "api.key.rotate",
  "action_context": "key-rotation",
  "details": {"old_key": "redacted", "new_key": "redacted"},
  "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/rlk/cryptoKeys/rlk-01",
  "rbac_change": "role.grant:service-account"
}
```

irene: +1 on kms_key_id. we need clear rules on PII in `details` — customer-facing audit events must either redact or provide a deterministic reference token to a secure evidence log.

kai: runtime team notes: we currently emit error traces and model load logs, but we do NOT emit config-change events (quantization, model weights swapped, compilation flags). need hooks for model.load, model.swap, model.config.update.

matt: billing: gaps include rate-limit overrides, manual invoice adjustments, plan changes, and quota exemptions. also need to surface who performed the change (user vs internal system).

sanju: auth gaps preliminary: `oauth.client.create`, `oauth.client.rotate_secret`, `password.reset_by_admin`, `role.binding.update`, `service-account.key.create/rotate/delete`. adding unit tests for these.

laura: proposal for backlog priority:
P0: events that affect customer security or billing (role.binding.update, oauth.client.rotate_secret, billing.invoice.adjust, service-account.key.*)
P1: KMS instrumentation and runtime model ops (model.swap, model.config.update)
P2: console UX events, schema cleanup, retention defaults

security-bot: Incident watch: detected 2 suspicious `role.grant` events in staging around 16:41 UTC. Created triage ticket INC-487 and alerted oncall.

laura: thanks — @matt please own billing P0 items, @kai own runtime P1/P0 split, @sanju own auth P0 items and tests. I'll coordinate product comms for customer-facing schema changes and versioning.

matt: acknowledged. I'll add an integration test that asserts `billing.adjustment` events contain `actor`, `amount_delta`, `reason`, and `invoice_ref`. will post PR link.

kai: runtime P0 ack. estimate ~2 sprints to add hooks, validations, and e2e tests unless we isolate hotfix patches for critical events.

irene: I'll draft a redact policy and KMS exposure policy — include examples of what to redact in `details` and how to reference secure evidence IDs. also will propose retention defaults (90d customer-facing, 365d internal).

laura: next step: synchronous triage tomorrow 10:00am PT to review P0 slices and assign sprint owners. Calendar invite sent. please bring quick yes/no on migration complexity for your domain. Thanks all :thumbsup:
